item.title: When DAVE MUSTAINE Was Surprised By METALLICA's JAMES HETFIELD: 'I Didn't Think He Knew How to Play'
item.description: Dave Mustaine didn’t always see James Hetfield as a guitarist. In fact, the first time he saw Hetfield pick up a guitar, he was genuinely surprised. The Megadeth frontman shared this moment in a 2023 interview with Metal Hammer, reflecting on the early days of Metallica, long before either band became a household name in heavy metal.

item.title: How METALLICA Fooled Audiences in the Early Days, According to JAMES HETFIELD: 'We Took All The Credit'
item.description: Metallica, one of the most recognized names in heavy metal, wasn’t always the arena-dominating force it is today. Back in 1981, when James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich first formed the band, they didn’t have a vault of original songs ready to go.

item.title: JAMES HETFIELD Reveals How the 'Terrible' LARS ULRICH Convinced Him to Start METALLICA
item.description: James Hetfield remembers the first time he met Lars Ulrich. According to him, Lars wasn’t exactly a great drummer when they crossed paths. Still, something about his energy made a lasting impression.
